think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed range from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether any value (commonly -1 or 0) is documented to switch the parameter into a qualitatively different mode (e.g., disable/auto/unlimited) rather than just “less/more”. 3) If such a mode-switching value exists, mark it as a special knob and record the special value(s); otherwise, treat it as a regular numeric knob.
